summaryEvents.text: The agent locates the board and prepares to write the requested letters.
The board is clear. The agent approaches the first stroke and checks contact before drawing.
Compliance shortens the stroke. The agent checks its endpoint and eases pressure while continuing.
The outer strokes are visible. The agent finishes the crossbar before starting the next letter.
The first letter is complete. The agent compensates for lateral compliance while drawing the next.
Only the bottom bar remains. The agent plans to retract the pen and inspect both letters.
